description: This Java class implements a MiniLang operation <get-related-one> for retrieving a related entity in the Apache OFBiz framework, featuring attribute validation, execution logic to fetch related entities, artifact information gathering, and a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Implements the MiniLang <get-related-one> element for fetching a related entity based on specified attributes within a MiniLang process.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation to retrieve a related entity value and stores it in the environment map, handling exceptions and logging warnings if errors occur.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information related to the relation name for documentation or analysis purposes.
